articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is estimated to have become the biggest entertainment launch in history following the blockbuster video game's debut on Thursday , after a 13-year wait.
key_points: The highly anticipated open-world action-adventure saw pre-orders and first day sales total more than 24.5 million units, raking in about $2.36bn (£1.8bn), according to analytics platform Sensor Tower.
In comparison, this year's highest grossing movie so far, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, made $2.5bn over its entire run in cinemas .
